descriptions.text: The best projects start with the best products. Start your projects with our high-quality cardstock, formulated especially for discerning crafters. It's thicker than standard cardstock, so it's perfect for card bases. The ultrasmooth surface is ideal for stamping, so you get clean, crisp images. * 24 sheets * 8-1/2" x 11" * Acid free * Lignin free

images.description: Blank white cardstock and paper products displayed on a gray wood-textured surface, showing various sizes of flat, unprinted sheets in white. The composition includes what appears to be letter-size and smaller card-size sheets arranged in an overlapping layout, with a partial view of additional paper on the right edge.

A taupe and cream-colored two-part punch tool featuring a gingerbread man design. The top portion has a circular punch mechanism with a white gingerbread figure icon, while the bottom base plate displays a matching gingerbread silhouette. This is a single punch tool with a lever-action design typical of crafting punches.

A blank white rectangular card or cardstock sheet displayed against a neutral gray background. The product appears to be a single piece of heavyweight white paper or cardstock with clean edges and subtle shadowing around its perimeter.

descriptions.text: One punch, two sizes of balloons! Punches are a quick and easy way to add interest and depth to your projects. And there’s no better way to cut out stamped images—many of our stamp sets have coordinating punches. Our punches are high quality, affordable, and easy to use. * Sleek body style * Large surface area offers precise cutting and leverage * Locks to store * Slim and stackable

images.description: A brown die-cutting machine or embossing tool with two large circular openings on the face, accompanied by five light blue balloon-shaped die-cuts in various sizes arranged beside it. The tool features a neutral beige accent stripe and control buttons on the lower portion.
